description: Source code for a map generation dialog and generator class in the Wesnoth game, including user interface for map parameters and map creation logic.

classes.name: default_map_generator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating maps with configurable parameters and user interface for map settings.

methods.name: allow_user_config
methods.description: Returns true, indicating user can configure map parameters.

methods.name: user_config
methods.description: Displays a GUI dialog allowing the user to set map generation parameters.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the map generator.

methods.name: create_map
methods.description: Creates a map based on current parameters and arguments.

methods.name: generate_map
methods.description: Generates the map data string with optional labels based on current parameters.

methods.name: create_scenario
methods.description: Creates a scenario configuration including generated map data and labels.
